config_file.description: Path to the configuration file itself or a reference to where this config is stored.

listen_address.description: IP address for the proxy to listen on for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: Port number for the proxy to listen on.

auth_enabled.description: Whether to enable authentication for incoming proxy connections.

auth_username.description: Username for authenticating incoming proxy connections.

auth_password.description: Password for authenticating incoming proxy connections.

atem_host.description: IP address or hostname of the Blackmagic ATEM switcher.

atem_port.description: Port number of the ATEM switcher's control protocol.

atem_retry_interval.description: Interval in seconds to retry connection to the ATEM switcher.

mqtt_qos.description: Quality of Service level for MQTT messages.

midi_port.description: Path to the MIDI device or port name.

midi_device_name.description: Name of the virtual MIDI device.
